source_note: PLACEHOLDER pedagogy. All numbers are invented/tunable, NOT official pedagogy. See docs/TO_VERIFY.md.

tier_coefficient_thresholds.why: PLACEHOLDER: coefficient >= core_min is CORE, coefficient <= light_max is LIGHT, otherwise STANDARD. Missing coefficient -> STANDARD.

max_weakness_multiplier_by_tier.why: PLACEHOLDER: a weak subject may be boosted, but never above its tier cap; a LIGHT subject gets no weakness boost at all.

weekly_minutes_floor_by_tier.why: PLACEHOLDER: every planned subject keeps a small weekly floor so a LIGHT subject is not fully starved.

weekly_minutes_ceiling_by_tier.why: PLACEHOLDER: hard per-tier weekly ceiling regardless of weakness or exam boost.

planning_mode_tier_step_why: PLACEHOLDER: MORE raises the weakness-cap tier one step (LIGHT->STANDARD->CORE, capped at CORE); TRACKING_ONLY removes the subject from planning entirely.

mastery.low_threshold_why: PLACEHOLDER: a topic below 0.5 mastery is weak enough to earn targeted REVIEW/EXERCISES demand.
mastery.high_threshold_why: PLACEHOLDER: at/above 0.85 mastery with HIGH confidence a topic is mastered and earns no demand.
mastery.min_confidence_why: PLACEHOLDER: only evidence-backed mastery (confidence >= LOW) may change demand; NONE is ignored.
mastery.topic_session_minutes_why: PLACEHOLDER: default length of a topic-targeted REVIEW/EXERCISES micro-session.
mastery.flashcard_session_minutes_why: PLACEHOLDER: short micro-session for clearing due flashcards.
mastery.revision_topics_max_why: PLACEHOLDER: before an exam, add revision demand for at most this many weakest topics per subject.
mastery.low_mastery_boost_why: PLACEHOLDER: multiplier applied to a weak topic's targeted demand before the tier cap.

EXAM_PROXIMITY.why: PLACEHOLDER: exams close in time should dominate ordering

WEAKNESS.why: PLACEHOLDER: weaker subjects should get earlier/bigger slots

DEFICIT.why: PLACEHOLDER: accrued deficit should be caught up

FOLLOWUP_DUE.why: PLACEHOLDER: follow-ups due sooner go first
